description: This file defines a Spring component class 'AutowiredTenantAdapter' which extends 'EventBusTenantAdapter' and manages dependency injection of 'TenantService' via Spring annotations. It essentially acts as an adapter connecting tenant management service to an event bus implementation in a Spring Boot environment.

classes.name: AutowiredTenantAdapter
classes.description: A Spring component implementing tenant management which extends EventBusTenantAdapter and injects a TenantService bean.

methods.name: setService
methods.description: Setter method for injecting TenantService bean, annotated with @Autowired and @Qualifier("backend").

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Returns the injected TenantService instance, overrides method from superclass.
